sections.heading: Part A: Multiplication facts
sections.instructions: Solve each multiplication fact. Write your answer on the line.

sections.heading: Part B: Division facts
sections.instructions: Solve each division fact. Think: what times the second number makes the first number?

sections.heading: Part C: Word problems
sections.instructions: Read each problem carefully. Show your work, then write the answer with a label.

problems.q: Maya has 6 bags. Each bag holds 4 apples. How many apples does she have in all?
A teacher shares 35 pencils equally among 5 tables. How many pencils does each table get?
There are 8 rows of chairs with 9 chairs in each row. How many chairs are there?
Leo reads 3 pages every day for 7 days. How many pages does he read?
Which number sentence matches 4 groups of 5 stars?
